sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: What is the central control unit in a smart home system that connects and manages all automated devices often called?
Which of the following is the most crucial structural element in an advertisement designed to instantly grab a reader's attention?
Fill in the blank: A ______ is a visual floor plan or layout designed to organize stalls and manage visitor crowd flow effectively during a Kaushal Mela.
In home automation, mechanical devices like smart locks or motorized blinds that perform physical actions based on received commands are technically called ____________.
Fill in the blank: The target __________ refers to the specific demographic or group of people a product advertisement is uniquely designed to reach and persuade.

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Briefly explain the primary function of a smart sensor in a basic home automation setup. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A smart sensor detects environmental changes, such as motion, temperature, or light levels, and instantly sends this data to the central hub to trigger automated actions.

questions.question_text: Define the practical purpose of including a 'Call to Action' (CTA) in a print advertisement. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A Call to Action directs the audience on what specific step to take next, such as calling a phone number, visiting a website, or buying a product.

questions.question_text: List two primary responsibilities of a student managing a project display stall at the school Kaushal Mela. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The student must clearly explain the working mechanism of their vocational project to visitors and keep the display area organized, safe, and visually appealing throughout the event.

questions.question_text: Suppose your class is organizing a Kaushal Mela exhibition to showcase vocational projects. Outline a quick operational strategy to ensure smooth visitor movement and avoid crowding at popular stalls. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, design a circular floor layout with clearly marked entrance and exit gates. Allocate wider spacing for highly interactive stalls. Assign student volunteers as ushers to guide attendees smoothly, preventing bottlenecks and ensuring everyone views all displayed projects comfortably.
